_comment: FPS JSON editor, Distances tab: the restraints table and the form of the selected restraint (the Qt tool's Details dialog).

sections.description: The distance restraints. A name is label1_label2. Click a row to edit it below; the Show box is the restraint's visible flag.

columns.title: Show
columns.description: Whether the restraint's line is drawn in the 3D tab.

columns.title: Name
columns.description: label1_label2, built from the two labels.

columns.title: Type
columns.description: dRDA (mean R_DA), dRDAE (mean FRET-averaged distance), dRMP (distance of the mean positions) or pRDA (a distribution).

columns.title: Details
columns.description: Forster radius, distance and errors, or the number of points of the distribution.

columns.title: Score set
columns.description: The scoring group that lists the restraint.

sections.title: Selected restraint
sections.description: Labels, type, scoring group and the numbers of the selected restraint.

sections.label: Label 1
sections.description: First position (every position of the Positions tab).

sections.label: Label 2
sections.description: Second position; it must differ from the first.

sections.label: Type
sections.description: dRDA: mean R_DA; dRDAE: mean FRET-averaged distance; dRMP: distance of the mean positions; pRDA: a distribution loaded from a file.

sections.label: Score set
sections.description: The scoring group (chi-squared set) that includes the restraint; empty = none.

sections.label: Forster radius (R0, A)
sections.description: Forster radius of the dye pair in angstrom.
